children: PermRock Royalty Trust declared a monthly cash distribution of $197,140.34 ($0.016204 per unit) payable November 16, 2026, based principally on August 2026 production. The distribution reflects oil receipts of approximately $1.01 million, natural gas receipts of approximately $0.04 million, and total direct operating expenses of $0.46 million for the period. T2S Permian Acquisition II informed the Trust of primary drivers: lower oil sales volumes, higher natural gas prices, and decreased operating and workover expenses.
Monthly cash distribution declared: $197,140.34 total; $0.016204 per Trust Unit (payable November 16, 2026; record date October 30, 2026).
Oil cash receipts for the period: approximately $1.01 million.
Natural gas cash receipts for the period: approximately $0.04 million.
Total direct operating expenses (including marketing, lease operating and workover expenses): $0.46 million.
Severance and ad valorem taxes included in net profits calculation: $0.05 million; capital expenditures: $10,693.

Underlying production for the current month (attributable to the net profits interest calculation) included 12,603 barrels of oil (407 Bbls/D) and 18,137 Mcf of natural gas (585 Mcf/D), based principally on August 2026 production.
Average received wellhead prices for the period were $79.75 per barrel of oil and $1.97 per Mcf of natural gas.
T2S reported a decrease in oil sales volumes versus the prior month, driving the decline in oil cash receipts from the prior period.
Natural gas receipts rose primarily due to higher natural gas prices, partially offset by lower gas volumes.

The net profits calculation included a $62,500 holdback (gross) for future ad valorem taxes, netting $50,000 to the Trust; a $62,500 release included in the prior month was the gross amount, with $50,000 net to the Trust.
